as_told.title: Roger Leir's book: Humanitas doctors' contact with a being

plain: In 1996, in the Brazilian town of Varginha where a strange creature was reportedly captured, two doctors at Humanitas Hospital are said to have met with a doctor named Roger Leir and told him about a creature they had treated and that communicated with them by telepathy. The UFO investigator James Fox tells it from Leir's taped interviews and his book on the case, saying Leir "describes a meeting with these two doctors at a hospital." On a later episode Fox adds that this part appears in the book but not in the tapes.
